classification.model: lora-distilbert-multilingual-v1 (falls back to baseline if untrained)

evidence_sufficiency.note: Measures whether the sufficiency gate's SUFFICIENT/INSUFFICIENT decision matches human judgment of real corpus coverage (data/benchmark/end_to_end/ground_truth.json). This is the Milestone 10 finding, now a real measured number.

reasoning.reason: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured in this environment - the LLM was never called. See reports/reasoning/report.md.

citation_verification.reason: Depends on real LLM output (see 'reasoning' above). The citation verification logic itself is unit-tested against constructed adversarial findings - see backend/tests/test_citation_verification.py.
